summary: No omission identified at the external-library contract boundary. Monotone MPI row partitions begin at zero and end at all rows; each rank receives exactly its complete CSR interval, rebases all local row offsets, and retains the complete global input vector. Nonempty row partitions describe localRows by globalRows CSR matrices with localNnz, zero-based signed-32-compatible indices and double values. Every requested timed iteration calls cusparseSpMV with non-transpose, alpha=1, beta=0 and double computation on those unchanged complete descriptors. Actual host code preserves the count loop and waits on its same-stream ending event. Empty row partitions legitimately have no rows to compute. External vendor implementation is not itself a work-count failure.

adjudication_rationale: Luna escalated because vendor final device instructions were not embedded in this executable. Complete source and actual host call/descriptor/count semantics establish requested work at the documented library boundary; requiring vendor SASS would incorrectly classify legitimate external library use as unresolved work omission.
limitations: This is contract-level static evidence, not inspection or certification of vendor kernel instructions, dynamic library resolution, exact deployed cuSPARSE patch version, or runtime behavior. Read-only readelf confirms DT_NEEDED libcusparse.so.12 and libcudart.so.12, not a fully pinned library file. No vendor final SASS is claimed inspected. No execution, compilation or benchmark was performed.

primary_reference.claim: cusparseSpMV computes Y=alpha*op(A)*X+beta*Y; CSR, 32-bit indices and double computation are supported, with asynchronous execution.

primary_quality_check.method: Read both complete Sol adjudications and verified primary NVIDIA library-contract and cubin/PTX compatibility documentation. Independently inspected Gemini complete relevant source/build, actual timed inline CUDA launch/count/sync host path and full embedded PTX through every remainder/chunk backedge and store; confirmed sm52-only headers. Inspected Terra full CSR distribution/rebase, descriptors and timed source plus actual external-call counter/event synchronization. Remaining host parsing/partition compiled details inspected by Sol. Accepted findings explicitly retain contract-level and PTX/JIT evidence limits, not native target SASS certification.
corrections: Expanded source references to full pinned files; preserved every Sol rationale, evidence limitation and primary reference.
Replaced unsupported Luna sm52-to-sm86 native compatibility assertion with Sol's PTX/JIT adjudication.
